answer: Vouching chains with decaying trust: a new identity earns weight only through vouches from established members, and each hop from a verified root multiplies trust by 0.6, so a lantern of credibility fades quickly down a chain. A voucher stakes 20 POA per vouch for 40 epochs and loses it if the vouched key is later flagged. A sybil ring must therefore buy real stake for every fake, a spiral of rising cost, while auditors verify chain depth and stake on-chain; umber-grade low-trust keys earn almost nothing.
